keyword: cute things to say to your boyfriend

reviews.summary: Answers the search with lines sorted by moment and a table that makes them personal, but two lines read as lifted from every other list: the cute-cumber pun and the weather-forecast morning text.

Every product claim and link checks out. 'I'm not busy for anyone else tonight' said the opposite of what it meant; the Spanish had a calque of it, 'enfadarme contigo' for angry on his behalf, 'no eres tú' (the break-up line), 'querer a' plus infinitive, a Latin American 'igual', a doubled 'llegan', a vosotros/tú switch and a description missing 'sin motivo'.

Sorting by moment and the borrowed-versus-yours table beat page one, but every top result leads with compliments and thank-yous and the post had no section for them; the morning heading used the queued good-morning post's search.

applied: Replaced the cute-cumber pun and the forecast line with lines about a sister at Sunday dinner and his mug next to hers (ES matches); takeaway now says 'joke' rather than 'pun'.
New section 'Sweet compliments and thank-yous to tell him' / 'Piropos y gracias bonitos para decirle'.
Morning heading now 'Cute things to say to your boyfriend in the morning' / 'Cosas bonitas para decirle a tu novio por la mañana'.
'Tonight I'm busy for everyone but you' / 'ocupada para todo el mundo menos para ti'.

ES: 'que me enfade por ti', 'funcionan', 'Lo malo ha sido el día, no tú' (lead and list), 'lo que me gusta quedarme en la cama', 'Y te va a salir bien igualmente', 'Haz un álbum', description includes 'sin motivo' (shortened to fit 160 characters).

Polish taken: blankets line made clear, ES title 'en cada momento', 'cuando te acabas de levantar', 'Siento lo que dije. No lo decía en serio', repeated 'one message a day' takeaway cut, older post link reads 'list of cute things…' / 'lista de cosas bonitas…'.
rejected: Polish not taken: an extra flirty in-person line (adds text without fixing anything).
